chunks: When you encamp against the enemy or he encamps against you,
let your camp be on the approaches of the high ground, or on the edges of the mountains, or along the rivers, so that it may serve you as a help and a place to return to.
And your fighting should be from one side or two sides.
Place watchers on the peaks of the mountains and the raised sides of the high ground,
so that the enemy may not approach you from any place, whether of danger or safety.

key_terms.مَنَاكِبِ الْهِضَابِ: raised sides of the high ground

ai.seo_question: What are the strategic principles for military encampment and battle formation in Shia Islamic tradition?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) outlines tactical encampment principles that reflect the strategic acumen of early Islamic warfare, prioritizing high ground and natural barriers to ensure both offensive readiness and defense against surprise attacks. This guidance underscores the Shia emphasis on combining spiritual discipline with practical military science, ensuring that the vanguard remains vigilant and unified in its approach to battle.

en.sayed-ali-raza: When you proceed towards the enemy or he proceeds towards you,
the position of your force should be on the approaches high ground or on the edges of mountains or the bends of rivers, so that it may serve you as a help and a place to return to.
Your encounter should be from one side or two sides.
Place watchers on the peaks of mountains and the raised sides of the high ground
so that the enemy may not approach you from any place, whether of danger or safety.
